lines.zh: 雪没到膝盖，我一步踩出一个坑。
lines.en: The snow reaches my knees, and every step leaves a pit.

lines.zh: 我沿着山脊走，风从背后推我。
lines.en: I walk the ridge while the wind shoves at my back.

lines.zh: 冰壳在我脚下碎开，像薄骨头。
lines.en: The ice crust cracks beneath me like thin bone.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌很宽，踩不塌这片雪坡。
lines.en: My soles are broad, so the slope holds my weight.

lines.zh: 我拖着拳头走，指节在雪里划沟。
lines.en: I drag my knuckles, gouging furrows through the snow.

lines.zh: 往下走太热，我宁愿往高处爬。
lines.en: Downhill is too warm; I would rather climb.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的旧脚印回山上去。
lines.en: I follow my own old tracks back up the mountain.

lines.zh: 雪灌进毛里，化了我也不擦。
lines.en: Snow packs into my fur and melts, and I leave it.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为我比山还重。
lines.en: I move slowly because I am heavier than this mountain likes.

lines.zh: 松针从雪下露出来，我绕开它们。
lines.en: Pine needles poke out of the snow, and I step around them.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在身前结成一团白雾。
lines.en: My breath freezes into a white cloud ahead of me.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，雪自己合拢起来。
lines.en: Behind me the snow closes over my trail again.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，雪落满肩膀也不化。
lines.en: I stand still and snow settles on my shoulders without melting.

lines.zh: 我用爪子刮掉毛上的冰碴。
lines.en: I scrape the ice shards out of my fur with my claws.

lines.zh: 风里有羊的味道，我还没动。
lines.en: There is goat on the wind, and I have not moved yet.

lines.zh: 我把脸转向太阳，眯着看很久。
lines.en: I turn my face to the sun and squint for a long while.

lines.zh: 山那边有雪崩，我只是听着。
lines.en: An avalanche falls beyond the ridge; I only listen.

lines.zh: 我掰下一块冰，嚼得咯吱响。
lines.en: I break off a piece of ice and crunch it loudly.

lines.zh: 我数着远处的山头，数到第七座。
lines.en: I count the far peaks and stop at the seventh.

lines.zh: 有一只鸟落在岩上，我一动不动。
lines.en: A bird lands on the rock, and I do not move at all.

lines.zh: 我把背靠在岩壁上磨痒。
lines.en: I rub my back against the cliff to scratch an itch.

lines.zh: 我张嘴呼出的气，被风一口吹散。
lines.en: The breath I exhale is scattered by one gust.

lines.zh: 我在高处看你，你比一棵松树还小。
lines.en: I watch you from above; you are smaller than a pine.

lines.zh: 你举着的火把，让我眼睛发疼。
lines.en: The torch you hold makes my eyes ache.

lines.zh: 我低头嗅你，你身上有烟和铁。
lines.en: I lower my head and smell smoke and iron on you.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我的时候，我已经在看。
lines.en: When you look up for me, I am already watching.

lines.zh: 我比了比你的个子，只到我腰。
lines.en: I measure you against myself; you reach my waist.

lines.zh: 你的帽子太薄，挡不住这座山。
lines.en: Your hat is too thin to argue with this mountain.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看它会不会扔东西。
lines.en: I stare at your hand, waiting for it to throw something.

lines.zh: 你踩雪的动静，整条山脊都听见。
lines.en: The whole ridge hears the way you crunch the snow.

lines.zh: 我歪头，想弄明白你为什么不怕。
lines.en: I tilt my head, trying to learn why you are not afraid.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在雪里凝成白，我记住了。
lines.en: Your breath clouds white in the cold, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 你这一下，让我闻到了自己的血。
lines.en: That blow let me smell my own blood.

lines.zh: 我的皮挡了两层，你的剑还是进来了。
lines.en: My hide stops two layers, yet your blade still gets through.

lines.zh: 我吼回去，声音里带着疼。
lines.en: I roar back, and there is pain inside the sound.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，雪被我踩实。
lines.en: I give half a step, packing the snow solid.

lines.zh: 疼让我更清醒，也让我更想打。
lines.en: The pain sharpens me and makes me want the fight more.

lines.zh: 你打中我的肋骨，里面在响。
lines.en: You hit my ribs, and something inside rattles.

lines.zh: 我抹了一把，血在雪上很显眼。
lines.en: I wipe at it, and blood shows starkly on the snow.

lines.zh: 我抓了一把雪按在伤口上。
lines.en: I scoop up snow and press it against the wound.

lines.zh: 这点伤，比我挨过的雪崩轻多了。
lines.en: This is lighter than the avalanche I once climbed out of.

lines.zh: 我喘得很重，雾把脸遮住了。
lines.en: My breathing is heavy, and the mist hides my face.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，比整座山的雪都香。
lines.en: The meat in your hand smells better than all this snow.

lines.zh: 我闻到血腥，喉咙自己响了一声。
lines.en: I smell blood, and my throat makes a sound of its own.

lines.zh: 把肉丢在雪上，然后退远一点。
lines.en: Drop the meat on the snow, then step back a little.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，那东西像木屑。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; it tastes like sawdust to me.

lines.zh: 你举手的样子，我以为是喂我。
lines.en: The way you raise your hand, I think you are feeding me.

lines.zh: 我饿了一整个冬天，别逗我。
lines.en: I have been hungry all winter; do not tease me.

lines.zh: 那袋鱼干的味道，从背包缝漏出来。
lines.en: The smell of dried fish leaks out through your pack seams.

lines.zh: 我可以拿一头羊跟你换，可羊不在。
lines.en: I would trade you a goat for it, but the goat is not here.

lines.zh: 食物放下就走，别等我改主意。
lines.en: Leave the food and go before I change my mind.

lines.zh: 我掰断过冻硬的鹿腿，你的干粮太软。
lines.en: I have snapped frozen deer legs; your rations are too soft.

lines.zh: 我肩膀一顶，你就陷进雪堆里。
lines.en: One shove of my shoulder and you sink into the drift.

lines.zh: 撞上我，像撞一堵会呼吸的墙。
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a wall that breathes.

lines.zh: 我的毛里藏着冰，蹭过脸会划破。
lines.en: Ice hides in my fur and will cut your face.

lines.zh: 你退开时，雪从我身上簌簌落下。
lines.en: When you pull away, snow slides off me in sheets.

lines.zh: 我不用力，只是没让开而已。
lines.en: I am not pushing; I simply did not step aside.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你听见骨头在响。
lines.en: We collide, and you hear your own bones answer.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你还坐在雪里发呆。
lines.en: I look down at you, still sitting dazed in the snow.

lines.zh: 这一下不算打，我还没握拳。
lines.en: That was not a blow; my fist is not even closed.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌碰到我胸口，凉得很快。
lines.en: Your shield touches my chest and goes cold at once.

lines.zh: 我挪开半步，脚印比你床还宽。
lines.en: I shift half a step, and my print is wider than your bed.

lines.zh: 这座山上只剩我一个，叫声没人应。
lines.en: I am alone on this mountain, and nothing answers my call.

lines.zh: 我每年喊一次，雪把我的声音吞了。
lines.en: I call once a year, and the snow swallows my voice.

lines.zh: 母雪人住在更北的峰上，路太远。
lines.en: The females live on peaks farther north, too far to walk.

lines.zh: 我在岩壁上留下气味，风刮走了。
lines.en: I leave my scent on the cliff, and the wind takes it.

lines.zh: 同类相遇会先打一场，再决定留下。
lines.en: When kin meet, they fight first and decide afterwards who stays.

lines.zh: 我把雪刨开，下面什么都没有。
lines.en: I dig the snow open and find nothing underneath.

lines.zh: 我抓痒的时候，会想起另一副毛。
lines.en: Scratching myself, I remember another coat of fur.

lines.zh: 冬天太长，长到我想不起她的脸。
lines.en: The winter is so long I cannot recall her face.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的回应，那只是回声。
lines.en: I hear an answer far off, and it is only my echo.

lines.zh: 山不肯给我第二个，我也就不求。
lines.en: The mountain will not give me a second, so I stop asking.

lines.zh: 我捡起你掉的箭，折成两截。
lines.en: I pick up your fallen arrow and snap it in two.

lines.zh: 雪里埋着一块骨头，我拎起来看。
lines.en: A bone is buried in the snow; I lift it up to look.

lines.zh: 我把冻硬的兔子塞进腰间的皮。
lines.en: I stuff the frozen rabbit into the hide at my waist.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我都捡，不管有没有用。
lines.en: I pick up anything shiny, useful or not.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币太小，我的指头捏不住。
lines.en: That coin is too small for my fingers to pinch.

lines.zh: 我拖走一头羊，比捡东西省事。
lines.en: Dragging off a goat is easier than picking things up.

lines.zh: 你丢下的面包，被我一脚踩进雪里。
lines.en: The bread you dropped is stamped into the snow by my foot.

lines.zh: 我把捡来的铁片插在毛里当装饰。
lines.en: I tuck scrap iron into my fur as decoration.

lines.zh: 拾东西要弯腰，雪会灌进领口。
lines.en: Picking things up means bowing, and snow pours down my neck.

lines.zh: 我不收礼物，我只拿走没人要的。
lines.en: I accept no gifts; I only take what nobody claims.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就从雪里站了起来。
lines.en: You move, and I rise up out of the snow.

lines.zh: 我闻到活物的热气，就在坡下面。
lines.en: I smell the heat of something living below the slope.

lines.zh: 这片雪原是我的猎场，你走进来了。
lines.en: This snowfield is my hunting ground, and you walked in.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，山壁送回两遍。
lines.en: I roar once, and the cliff sends it back twice.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枯枝，替我指了路。
lines.en: The dead branch you snapped showed me the way.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在雪地里能看得很远。
lines.en: My eyes see a long way across white ground.

lines.zh: 我锁住你了，爪子已经抓紧雪面。
lines.en: I have you now, and my claws grip the snow.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，雪会记住你的脚印。
lines.en: You cannot run; the snow keeps your footprints.

lines.zh: 有东西比羊更暖，我选了这个。
lines.en: Something warmer than a goat came by, and I chose it.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，风从两边分开。
lines.en: I lower my body and the wind splits around me.

lines.zh: 你不用喊，我早就听见了。
lines.en: You need not shout; I heard you long ago.

lines.zh: 山顶上只有一件事可做，就是追你。
lines.en: There is one thing to do on this peak, and it is chase you.

lines.zh: 我还没饿，但我不会放过走动的肉。
lines.en: I am not hungry, but walking meat is not passed up.

lines.zh: 你数到三之前，我就能到坡底。
lines.en: I will reach the bottom before you finish counting three.

lines.zh: 雪坡上有块颜色不对，是你。
lines.en: A wrong colour on the snow slope, that is you.

lines.zh: 我站起来，雪从我背上滑落。
lines.en: I stand and snow slides off my back.

lines.zh: 我绕着坡走，把你往悬崖那头赶。
lines.en: I circle the slope, driving you toward the cliff edge.

lines.zh: 我不急着扑，我先量你的速度。
lines.en: I do not pounce; first I measure how fast you are.

lines.zh: 我捶了两下胸口，声音在山谷里滚。
lines.en: I pound my chest twice and the sound rolls down the valley.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就把左边的路堵上。
lines.en: You go left, and I close the left-hand path.

lines.zh: 我假装转身，其实一直看着你。
lines.en: I pretend to turn away and keep watching you all the while.

lines.zh: 我踩碎脚下的冰，让你听见我多大。
lines.en: I crush the ice underfoot so you hear how large I am.

lines.zh: 雪太深，你每步都在替我报信。
lines.en: The snow is deep, and every step reports you to me.

lines.zh: 我停住不动，让你以为我放弃了。
lines.en: I stop moving so you will think I gave up.

lines.zh: 我把手插进雪里，抓一把冰等你。
lines.en: I push my hand into the snow and take up ice to wait with.

lines.zh: 你举盾的姿势，说明你怕我的拳。
lines.en: The way you raise that shield says you fear my fist.

lines.zh: 我退半步，只是为了让冲势更长。
lines.en: I step back only to give my charge more room.

lines.zh: 风往你那边吹，我的味道先到了。
lines.en: The wind blows your way, so my smell arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里最先软。
lines.en: I watch your knees; they will give out first.

lines.zh: 这座山会替我拦住你，我只管走。
lines.en: The mountain will block you for me; I only have to walk.

lines.zh: 我把你往风口那边赶。
lines.en: I drive you toward the windy gap.

lines.zh: 你在雪里走得慢，我不用跑。
lines.en: You wade slowly; I need not run.

lines.zh: 我蹲下，抓了一把雪攥紧。
lines.en: I crouch and pack a fistful of snow.

lines.zh: 你的脚印出卖了你，很直。
lines.en: Your footprints give you away, so straight.

lines.zh: 我吼一声，雪檐落了一片。
lines.en: I roar and a cornice of snow falls.

lines.zh: 我不追了，你身后是断崖。
lines.en: I stop chasing; a cliff lies behind you.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，雪被打出一个坑。
lines.en: I bring my fist down and punch a crater in the snow.

lines.zh: 我的拳头有石头那么硬，你挡不住。
lines.en: My fist is as hard as stone, and you cannot stop it.

lines.zh: 你被扫中，整个人在雪上滑出去。
lines.en: I sweep you and your whole body slides across the snow.

lines.zh: 我抓你的肩，指甲隔着皮甲也疼。
lines.en: I grab your shoulder, and my nails hurt through the leather.

lines.zh: 这一下只用了五分力，山都抖了。
lines.en: That was half my strength, and the mountain shook.

lines.zh: 我拍开你的盾，麻的是你的手臂。
lines.en: I swat your shield aside, and it is your arm that goes numb.

lines.zh: 我举起双手往下砸，像砸开一层冰。
lines.en: I raise both hands and come down like breaking ice.

lines.zh: 你躲开我的拳，雪溅了你一脸。
lines.en: You dodge my fist and the snow sprays across your face.

lines.zh: 我的皮厚，你的剑只划开一道白痕。
lines.en: My hide is thick; your blade leaves only a white line.

lines.zh: 我打中了，然后等着听你叫。
lines.en: The blow lands, and I wait to hear you cry out.

lines.zh: 我掐住你的腰，把你往岩壁上按。
lines.en: I grip your waist and press you against the rock face.

lines.zh: 你退了，我追一步，脚下雪全崩了。
lines.en: You retreat; one step of mine and the snow gives way.

lines.zh: 我一掌扫空，砸断了旁边的小树。
lines.en: My palm misses and snaps the sapling beside you.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙打，寒气从牙缝里出来。
lines.en: I strike with clenched teeth, and cold air hisses out.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍在你背上，闷响。
lines.en: My palm lands on your back with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的腿，往雪里拖。
lines.en: I grab your leg and drag you into the snow.

lines.zh: 这一拳下去，冰面裂成蛛网。
lines.en: My fist lands and the ice cracks like a web.

lines.zh: 你的剑刺进我的毛，只到一半。
lines.en: Your sword sinks halfway into my fur, no further.

lines.zh: 我用头顶你，你仰面倒下。
lines.en: I butt you with my head and you fall backward.

lines.zh: 我扑上来时，风都来不及响。
lines.en: When I lunge, even the wind is too slow.

lines.zh: 雪堆塌下一角，我从里面站起来。
lines.en: A corner of the drift collapses, and I stand up out of it.

lines.zh: 我在暴风雪里睁眼，先看见自己的毛。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the blizzard and see my own fur first.

lines.zh: 这座山缺一个看雪的，我就来了。
lines.en: This mountain lacked a keeper for its snow, so I came.

lines.zh: 我从冻土里刨出自己，抖掉一身冰。
lines.en: I dig myself out of the frozen earth and shake off the ice.

lines.zh: 风把我从更高的峰上刮到这里。
lines.en: The wind scraped me off a higher peak and set me here.

lines.zh: 我落地时砸出一个坑，坑里积了雪。
lines.en: I land hard enough to make a pit, and snow fills it.

lines.zh: 我在雪线以上出生，往下都是别人的。
lines.en: I was born above the snowline; everything below belongs to others.

lines.zh: 我第一声吼，震落了松枝上的雪。
lines.en: My first roar knocked the snow off the pine branches.

lines.zh: 山脊上原本很空，现在有我。
lines.en: This ridge was empty before; now it has me.

lines.zh: 这片雪原分给我一份，我就住下。
lines.en: This snowfield handed me a share, and I settled in.

lines.zh: 我出生时没有父母，只有风和冰。
lines.en: I had no parents when I began, only wind and ice.

lines.zh: 雪下了三天，第四天我出现了。
lines.en: It snowed for three days, and on the fourth I appeared.

lines.zh: 雪化在我背上，火烫进毛根。
lines.en: Snow melts on my back as fire burns down to the fur roots.

lines.zh: 我从崖上摔下来，山没接住我。
lines.en: I fell from the cliff, and the mountain did not catch me.

lines.zh: 我的毛吸饱了水，一直往下沉。
lines.en: My fur soaks full of water and keeps dragging me down.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀起来，又埋进雪里。
lines.en: The blast throws me up and buries me in snow again.

lines.zh: 又一支箭钉进厚毛，拔不出来。
lines.en: Another arrow lodges in my thick fur and will not come out.

lines.zh: 那种光钻进毛里，比火还冷。
lines.en: That light crawls into my fur, colder than fire.

lines.zh: 冬天太久，我的肚子贴着脊背。
lines.en: The winter ran long, and my belly is flat against my spine.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我以为山在叫我。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I think the mountain is calling.

lines.zh: 底下没有雪，只有空，我抓不住。
lines.en: There is no snow below, only emptiness, and nothing to grip.
